transcript.text: Hello, I'm here to help you get ready for your appointment. Could you tell me what has been bothering you?
My sleep has been really bad, that's the main thing. I'm only getting about four hours a night and I'm exhausted all the time.
How long has your sleep been like this?
It started about three months ago, around the time I retired.
Do you have any allergies to medicines, or have you ever had a bad reaction to one?
No, I don't have any allergies to medicines that I know of.
Have you started or changed any medicines in the last three months?
Yes, I've been taking some over-the-counter sleeping tablets from the pharmacy — diphenhydramine — most nights for about three weeks now. My other medicines haven't changed.
Do you have any health problems that have lasted a long time?
Yes, I've got high blood pressure and an enlarged prostate. I take losartan 50 mg once a day for the blood pressure and tamsulosin 400 micrograms at night for the prostate.
Besides the trouble sleeping, have you noticed anything else that feels different or new for you?

My mood has been a bit low at times since I retired, though I haven't had any thoughts of harming myself. I'm also too tired to work on my allotment like I used to, and I find myself dozing off in the chair in the afternoon.
Can you tell me what your sleep has been like lately?

I fall asleep fine, usually around 11 pm, but then I wake up at 3 or 4 in the morning and can't get back to sleep. All told I get about four hours a night, and I'd rate it a 7 out of 10 for how bad it is.
Have you noticed anything that makes your sleep better or worse?
It's worse after late evenings watching TV, but on days I've been out for a long walk it tends to be a bit better.
When your sleep is bad, is that something you mainly notice in your head, mainly in your body, or you're not sure?
I'd say it's mostly a tiredness in my head and body both, really — I just feel worn out and groggy all day rather than any one thing standing out.
Aside from the high blood pressure and enlarged prostate you mentioned, is there anything else about your past health you’d like to add?
No, I think that's everything as far as my health history goes.
Is there anything else you'd like to add about your medicines?
No, those are the only ones — the losartan, the tamsulosin, and the diphenhydramine sleeping tablets.
Is there anything else you've noticed that seems to come along with the trouble you're having with sleep?
No loud snoring that I've noticed, and I've never nodded off while driving. Those are the main things alongside the tiredness and low mood.
When the tiredness comes on, is it more of an all-over feeling, does it tend to sit in one particular part of you, or are you not sure?
It's more of an all-over feeling, I'd say — just a general heaviness and lack of energy rather than anywhere specific.
Thank you, that is very helpful. I have put together a short summary of what you told me. Please read it and tell me if anything should be corrected before it goes to your doctor.
